2026-10-09ISEDBoards of Trade ActOrder Approving the changes of the boundaries of the district of the High River Chamber of Commerce, in AlbertaOrder approving the application by the High River Chamber of Commerce, in Alberta, to change the boundaries of its district from the High River district to the municipality of High River, with its boundary extending north to 466 Ave E, then running east where it intersects with Highway 2, then a diagonal line running south-east to the intersection of 498 Ave E and 144 Street E. The Eastern border is 144 Street E running north-south to Highway 23, then westward to Highway 2 and south to 594 Ave. The Southern Border is 594 Ave running east-west to 56 Street E and north to 562 Ave E. The Western border runs north-west from the 562 Ave and 56 Street E intersection to the intersection of Highway 783 and Coal Trail E, then northward to the intersection of Highway 783 and 466 Ave E.N/A
